name: Northwestern University Interdepartmental Neuroscience (NUIN) PhD Program
summary: Interdepartmental neuroscience doctoral training with at least three laboratory rotations before thesis laboratory selection.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application and all materials
deadlines.note: Page states 11:59 p.m.; timezone not stated, so no countdown time assigned.

english.note: MET minimum 61. Duolingo and TOEFL Essentials not accepted. English-instructed accredited degree may satisfy the requirement; scores valid for two years before matriculation. See Graduate School waiver rules.

applicationFee.note: Graduate School waivers require U.S. citizenship or permanent residency and qualifying eligibility; limited and first come, first served. No additional program waivers.

documents: Personal statement (125–250 words), distinct from academic statement
Unofficial transcript from each postsecondary institution
requirements.note: No writing sample required. Ideally at least one letter from a research supervisor. No strict GPA cutoff; solid hard-science preparation and significant laboratory research experience favored.

funding.note: All students guaranteed stipend, tuition and opt-in Northwestern student health insurance while in good standing. Full dental and vision subsidy. Published stipend explicitly 2025–26, not Fall 2027.
